title: Government getting ahead of service members ready to disclose

tellings.quote: And so many service people were on the verge of saying, "I can't not tell them what I saw."

plain: The idea is that the US government began speaking openly about UFOs from 2017 because it had to get ahead of its own people: so many service members had seen things that they were about to go public anyway. The economist Tyler Cowen puts it this way to Michels, passing on what he was told: "so many service people were on the verge of saying, 'I can't not tell them what I saw.'" If so, the official openness of those years was less a choice than damage control.
